title: Give the King Your Justice

questions.question: Give the king your justice, O God, and your righteousness to the royal what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:1 (ESV): "Give the king your justice, O God, and your righteousness to the royal son!"

questions.question: May he judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with what?
May the mountains bear prosperity for the people, and the hills, in what?
May he defend the cause of the poor of the people, give deliverance to the children of the needy, and crush the what?
May they fear you while the sun endures, and as long as the moon, throughout all what?
May he be like rain that falls on the mown grass, like showers that water the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:6 (ESV): "...like showers that water the earth!"

questions.question: In his days may the righteous flourish, and peace abound, till the moon be no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:7 (ESV): "...till the moon be no more!"

questions.question: May he have dominion from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:8 (ESV): "...and from the River to the ends of the earth!"

questions.question: May his foes lick the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:9 (ESV): "...and his foes lick the dust!"

questions.question: Long may he live; may gold of Sheba be given to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:15 (ESV): "Long may he live; may gold of Sheba be given to him!"

questions.question: May his name endure forever, his fame continue as long as the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:17 (ESV): "...his fame continue as long as the sun!"

questions.question: May people be blessed in him, all nations call him what?
Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who alone does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:18 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things."

questions.question: Blessed be his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:19 (ESV): "may the whole earth be filled with his glory!"

questions.question: The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 72:20 (ESV): "The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended."

key_verse_text: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things. Blessed be his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and Amen!
